note: Stage-5E FINAL three-arm bounded navigation campaign: CV-Kalman vs global reachability vs runtime class-aware reachability, all at the production max_influence_radius 0.55 m. Exactly one thing varies: which predictor the costmap layer consumes, and the tracker publication flag that necessarily accompanies it. The nav2 params file -- hence MPPI and every critic weight, the planner, the costmap geometry and resolution -- is the SAME UNMODIFIED Stage-4F file in all three arms, so MPPI cannot have been tuned per arm. The three tracker files are pairwise one-line diffs: reachability_enabled false->true (CV->global) and reachability_class_aware false->true (global->class-aware). Map, world, start, goal, actor body, actor trajectory, release time, sensor model, AMCL, the Kalman filter, the CV predictor, the Stage-5B classifier, compound clustering, the reachability mathematics, the Stage-5C.1 contract and the capability-profile table are shared by construction, and the classifier executes identically in all three arms. NO ORACLE ARM: it is not a deployable configuration and is excluded from the architecture comparison. Ground truth is used by the trial runner for scoring and for commanding the scripted actor only, and never reaches /scan, the tracker, the costmap layer, the planner or the controller. PRODUCTION CONFIGURATION WAS NOT CHANGED: no file under src/ was written.
layer_percentiles: p95/p99 NOT INSTRUMENTED by the layer; mean and max are reported instead.
two_sigma_band_caveat: The pairwise bands are 2*sqrt(sem_left^2 + sem_right^2): a crude run-to-run noise bound at five repetitions per condition per arm, NOT a hypothesis test. A difference inside the band supports no claim of superiority.

conditions_not_run.reversal_or_acceleration_change: NOT RUN. The shared trial runner drives the scripted obstacle one-way at constant velocity (stage4f_trial.py:659). A reversal would require changing the scorer every earlier stage used. Existing two-arm evidence for this scenario class: validation/stage5c/planner_comparison.json (nav_reversal, CV vs global reachability, 3 trials per arm) and validation/stage4g8/results.csv (g8_reversal, CV production, 10 trials).
conditions_not_run.multi_obstacle: NOT RUN. The shared launch spawns exactly ONE scripted obstacle; adding a second would change the launch for every earlier stage. Stage-5D declined this condition for the same reason. Existing single-arm evidence: validation/stage4g8/results.csv (g8_multi2, g8_multi3, CV production).
